title: Example company: runway scenarios (example values, not data)
label: Scenario, not a forecast: every figure follows from the assumptions listed with it.

start_cash.meaning: cash in the bank at the start of month 1
start_cash.source: bank statement, last day of the month before month 1

start_customers.meaning: paying customers at the start of month 1

new_customers_per_month.source: average of the last 6 months, billing export

new_customers_growth.meaning: growth of new customers per month, 0.03 = 3 %

monthly_churn.meaning: customers lost in a month / customers at its start

price_per_customer_month.meaning: recurring revenue per customer per month

headcount_start.meaning: people paid at the start of month 1

hires_per_month.meaning: net hires per month (an average; 0.5 = one every two months)

cost_per_head_month.meaning: full monthly cost of one person

other_costs_month.meaning: all other operating costs in month 1

other_costs_growth.meaning: growth of other costs per month

funding_amount.meaning: cash received from a planned raise or loan (0 = none)
funding_amount.source: no raise in the base case

funding_month.meaning: month in which that cash arrives (0 = none)
funding_month.source: no raise in the base case

base.trigger: new customers and churn stay near the last six months

new_customers_per_month.source: founder: two largest channels slow down

downside.trigger: two months in a row with fewer than 9 new customers
